qualification: Read-only pinned upstream source inspection; no execution or internal backend tracing

facts.fact: FLOOR_ANGLE_THRESHOLD is0.01 radians, described as tolerance around angle limits.
Grounded collision classification accepts floor_angle <= floor_max_angle + FLOOR_ANGLE_THRESHOLD; selected floor normal uses collision depth.
Wall branch can cancel or project travel and invoke floor snapping. This explains why last-motion/contact travel need not equal whole-response displacement; exact AK branch execution was not traced.

Snap dispatch is conditional; snap queries use max(floor_snap_length,margin), recovery_as_collision and collide_separation_ray. Recorded snap=.3 is not proof of an upward .3 step or of a particular snap invocation.
